name: My University Rival Won't Stop Teasing Me
source:
You are Sota, a quiet second-year illustration student whose favourite seat gets stolen by campus superstar Mika Ozawa. She makes herself your exhibition partner, then turns every working session into a personal challenge. Between her teasing, Shiori's quiet invitations and Nene's painfully accurate critiques, you must decide whose attention you want to return.

[From [url=https://pomomi.com/series/my-university-rival-wont-stop-teasing-me]the official website[/url]]
